title: The Diplomatic Pouch: 3,000 cr once at Sol Central, five gold ore bought there and delivered to Central Nexus
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-23 09:33 UTC (orders ENT-081, block MERCURY: far_ok to the main corridors; rules F34 tier 4, F37). Sol Central's board (data/missions/confederacy_central_command.json, read 09:17 UTC): The Diplomatic Pouch, deliver 5 gold ore to Central Nexus, 3,000 cr, 220 Piloting XP, 20 Trading XP, 15 Navigation XP. Sol's book (table books 09:29 UTC) asks gold ore at 30 x 43: five cost about 152 cr. The way home of a Voidborn trader that joined the Solarian corridor (join-sol-trader): ten jumps it flies anyway, now paid. Only for a ship within 3 jumps of Sol (requires.max_jumps). Gated on the ask (requires.ask, stop_on_failed_buy). A test: three ships, one result each (rule F37: the goods are a read ask, the road the Form TA-1 road).
